ModMetaData.name: MurderRim - The Worker Drones
ModMetaData.description:
This Mod Simply adds, Worker Drones and a new faction from the web series "Murder Drones" utilizing the mod VRE - androids. (and Yes, There is some facial animation support.)
im still pretty new to modding, so If there are any issues or questions, feel free to let me know. Anyways, Thank you! :D
